title: Fogwhiskers
wikitext:
The '''Fogwhiskers''' were a [[kobold]] group based out of the [[Ruins of Breezehaven|old Breezehaven mine]] in [[Balor]]. When the [[Stormreaver clan]] and the [[Shadow Council]] returned to Balor, they claimed the mine from the kobolds and the Fogwhiskers were wiped out save for one, [[Snugg]].
